description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans serialization, specifically testing version tolerance features such as adding/removing fields and schema evolution. It includes test cases for round-trip serialization, handling of new and missing fields, and custom serializers for types involved in these tests.

classes.name: ManualVersionToleranceTests
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying Orleans serialization version tolerance behavior, including handling of added/removed fields and schema evolution.

classes.name: ObjectWithNewField
classes.description: Serializable class with a new field introduced, used to test deserialization of objects with missing fields from older binaries.

classes.name: ObjectWithNewFieldTypeSerializer
classes.description: Custom serializer for ObjectWithNewField that omits the NewField to simulate older binary formats.

classes.name: ObjectWithoutNewField
classes.description: Serializable class representing an older version without new fields, used to test compatibility with newer serialized data.

classes.name: ObjectWithoutNewFieldTypeSerializer
classes.description: Custom serializer for ObjectWithoutNewField that adds a new field during serialization, simulating newer versions.

classes.name: BaseType
classes.description: Base class with explicitly serialized fields, with custom schema for versioning.

classes.name: SubType
classes.description: Derived class extending BaseType, with additional fields, custom serializer handles versioned serialization.

classes.name: SubTypeSerializer
classes.description: Serializer for SubType, handling field IDs, order, and nulls according to schema evolution policies.

classes.name: BaseTypeSerializer
classes.description: Serializer for BaseType, managing its fields and versioning.

methods.name: VersionTolerance_RoundTrip_Tests
methods.description: Main test method executing round-trip serialization tests with various SubType instances to verify version tolerance mechanisms.

methods.name: RoundTripTest
methods.description: Performs serialization/deserialization roundtrip and asserts object equality and consistency.

methods.name: TestSkip
methods.description: Tests skipping unknown fields in incoming binary data to ensure forward compatibility.

methods.name: ObjectWithNewField
methods.description: Data class representing an object with a potential new field, used in versioning tests.

methods.name: ObjectWithNewFieldTypeSerializer
methods.description: Custom serializer that omits the new field to simulate older version object serialization.

methods.name: ObjectWithoutNewField
methods.description: Older version data class without the new field.

methods.name: ObjectWithoutNewFieldTypeSerializer
methods.description: Serializer that adds a new field during serialization, simulating newer version data.

methods.name: GetGeneratedSerializer
methods.description: Helper method to instantiate serializers for test object types.
